insert into map_barrier (uuid, map_id, x, y, rotation, scale_x, side) values
(#{barrier.uuid}, #{barrier.mapId}, #{barrier.x}, #{barrier.y}, #{barrier.rotation}, #{barrier.scaleX}, #{barrier.side})
on duplicate key update map_id=values(map_id),x=values(x),y=values(y),rotation=values(rotation),scale_x=values(scale_x),side=values(side)

insert into map_point (uuid, map_id, x, y, text) values
(#{point.uuid}, #{point.mapId}, #{point.x}, #{point.y},#{point.text})
on duplicate key update map_id=values(map_id),x=values(x),y=values(y),text=values(text)

insert into map_SkillBall (uuid, map_id, x, y) values
(#{SkillBall.uuid}, #{SkillBall.mapId}, #{SkillBall.x}, #{SkillBall.y})
on duplicate key update map_id=values(map_id),x=values(x),y=values(y)
